content:
Maya Thompson: ZenithLabs (ZEN-314) reported ACH returns with code 'account_closed' when attempting to pay INV-4992 ($4,120). They say the account was recently migrated to new banking partner. Need next steps to keep access live.
Samir Patel: Do we have the bank return detail from Stripe? If it's account_closed we need a new debit method or a wire. For <$5k we can approve same-day wire with a waiver.
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Charge failed for INV-4992. Stripe return: account_closed (code: bank_return_421). Suggested actions: request updated bank info or send wire instructions. Created ticket PAY-7729.
Maya Thompson: Customer provided routing 333000444 and says new acct is active but they have no voided check. They can provide bank statement screenshot.
Oliver Grant: Bank statement screenshot is fine for our one-time ACH verification but payments team needs to confirm acceptable proof. If they can provide that file, we can retry microdeposits tomorrow.
Nora Li: Quick decision: approve one-off wire for $4,120 plus $15 processing fee if customer signs waiver email. If they prefer retry, require statement upload and we can schedule microdeposit retry in 24-48hrs. 
Samir Patel: I'll send both options: (1) secure pay link for new card, (2) wire instructions with waiver. Draft wire payload: ```
Wire USD 4,120.00
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing: 333000444
Bank: NewBridge Financial
Ref: INV-4992 / ZEN-314
```
Maya Thompson: Sent wire instructions and waiver template. Customer replied "we'll wire now" and attached transfer confirmation screenshot. Forwarding to finance.
PaymentsBot: NOTE: Marking INV-4992 pending manual settlement. Created subtask PAY-7729-WIRE. Please upload bank trace or Receipt when available.
Nora Li: Acknowledged. Once we have bank trace, finance will reconcile and mark invoice paid. Maya, please cc billing@redwood.ai on the receipt.
Samir Patel: Thanks — will close thread after funds verified. :white_check_mark:
